entries.title: More for your pet and its room

items.title: 96 new things
items.text: 71 new things for your pet's room and 25 new things for it to wear, in every category. There are whole sets to build a room around: ice, the backrooms, under the sea, deep space, a workshop and a castle. Find them in the Decorate and Wear tabs.

items.title: Livelier decorations
items.text: The animated things in the room move for longer now: the aquarium fish swims across and back, the lava lamp rises, fairy lights chase along their string, a drop runs down the terrarium glass, and more.

items.title: Formatting
items.text: Messages can now be **bold**, *italic*, __underlined__ or ~~struck through~~, with `code`, > quotes and ||spoilers|| that stay hidden until clicked. Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I and Ctrl+U work in the message box.

items.title: Spoilers for pictures and videos
items.text: Before you send a picture or video, tap Spoiler on it: it shows blurred, with SPOILER over it, until someone clicks it.

items.title: More to collect, and milestones
items.text: Six more things to collect dew with after the Rainbow loom, from Comet catchers to The first rain, with more upgrades for each, all the way up to 400 of them. And about 180 milestones to reach along the way, a few of them secret: each one makes everything collect 1% more, for good. Find them in the Dew tab.

items.title: A livelier room
items.text: With the Dew tab open, your pet's room comes alive the further you get: dew dripping down the walls, sparkles, shooting stars and the northern lights, and a pool of dew on the floor that rises with your milestones and changes color as you go.

entries.title: Drops of every kind, and everyone's volume

items.title: Drops of every kind
items.text: Your pet's room gets more than rainbow drops now: eight kinds, from common Dewdrops and Firefly drops to rare Storm and Aurora drops and legendary Golden and Star drops. The rarer they are, the bigger and brighter, and the more they bring. Some bring dew at once, others a boost for a while: a Firefly drop doubles what you collect for 30 seconds. Turn on "Let drops fall anywhere in Rainlit" in the Dew tab and they'll fall wherever you are, to catch as they go.

items.title: Everyone's volume, your way
items.text: In a voice channel, right-click someone (on a phone, tap them in the channel's list) to set how loud they are for you, from 0 to 200%. Past 100% makes a quiet friend louder, and Mute for me quiets them just for you. It's remembered for each person.

items.title: Emoji that look the same everywhere
items.text: Rainlit now uses Twemoji for every emoji, so they look the same on every device, and the newest ones never show up as empty boxes. The emoji picker has them all too. Rather have your device's own? Turn on "Use my device's emoji" in Settings.

items.title: Events that repeat
items.text: Events can now repeat every week, every 2 weeks or every month. Past events have their own tab, with Plan again to set one up again in a click.

items.title: Plan things together
items.text: Events are at the top of each space's channels. Plan one for a time and a voice channel (or somewhere else), and everyone sees it in their own time and can say Going, Maybe or Can't. When it starts, everyone going gets a heads-up with a button to jump in.

items.title: See when people are free
items.text: Mark the hours you're usually free in Settings, in your own time zone. When someone plans an event, Who's free shows the week, brighter where more people are free, so it's easy to pick a time that works.

items.title: Lights and things for its room
items.text: Aurora and Disco lighting that moves, a plasma ball, a jukebox, a moon lamp, a UFO with its beam, nebula walls, a neon grid floor, and a meteor shower out the window.

items.title: Things to wear
items.text: The first things to wear that come with Glow: a wishing star over its head, LED shades, a neon collar and a galaxy sweater, each with a little sparkle or shimmer of its own.

entries.title: Lights, and more for your pet

items.title: Lighting
items.text: Pick a light for your pet's room in Decorate: daylight, warmer, cooler, or ones dew brings, like golden hour, lamplight, moonlight, candlelight and neon night, where its lamps and windows light up the room around them.

items.title: More for its room
items.text: 21 more things dew brings: a wood stove, a piano, a telescope, a chandelier, a cuckoo clock, rain boots, a puddle, new wallpapers and floors, fireflies and a rainbow out the window, and more.

items.title: More to wear
items.text: Aviators, a wizard hat, a halo, a cowboy hat, a raincoat, a tuxedo, 3D glasses, a monocle and more, in the Wear tab.

items.title: Bug Finder badge
items.text: Found a bug in Rainlit and told us? Now there's a badge for that: a firefly on your profile that counts every bug you've found. Settings > Feedback is the quickest way to tell us.

items.title: Noise suppression, Rainlit's own
items.text: Your mic is cleaned up before anyone hears it: fans, hum, keyboard clacks and clicks fade out, and your voice stays. Pick Standard, or Strong (a bigger model for loud places), and how strongly, in Settings under Voice and video. Or Off, to send your mic just as it is.

items.title: Put things anywhere
items.text: In Decorate, put in as many things as you like: on the floor, on the wall, rugs, and new things to hang from the ceiling, like a paper lantern, a pendant lamp and a hanging plant. Drag anything about (even the window), and tap it to flip it, make it a little bigger or smaller, or put it away. Your pet wanders in front of things and behind them.

entries.title: Things for your pet to wear

items.title: Dress it up
items.text: Bows, beanies, top hats, sunglasses, collars, bandanas, scarves, sweaters and more, got with dew in the new Wear tab. Tap one to try it on first. Your pet wears them everywhere: in its room, on your homepage, and when friends visit. And they stay yours, so a new pet can wear them too.

items.title: Pat it for dew
items.text: Pat your pet in its room and it shakes off dew. In the new Dew tab, get leaves, acorn cups, spiderwebs and more to collect it by themselves while Rainlit's open (they stay in the tab, never in its room), and upgrade them as you go. A happy pet collects more, and now and then a rainbow drop rolls down its window: catch it!

items.title: Things only dew brings
items.text: Spend it on new things for its room, just for looks: a rain barrel, a record player, a terrarium, a foggy morning out the window, and more. They're in Decorate, each with what it costs.

items.title: Bouncing logo
items.text: Your name drifts around your page like an old DVD player's logo, a new colour at every edge, and celebrates when it hits a corner just right. Click to send it off another way, and try to aim it in.

items.title: Mystify
items.text: The other old screensaver: neon shapes bouncing about, trailing echoes of themselves. They lean toward your pointer, and a click starts another one.

items.title: Snow globe
items.text: A little cabin in the snow. Click to shake it, and the snow swirls up and slowly settles again.

items.title: Constellations
items.text: A night sky whose stars join up around your pointer. Click, and a constellation's drawn there, with its name. All four are in your homepage's Page tab, under Background.

items.title: Scenes
items.text: Backgrounds that move, and that visitors can play with: a click or a tap anywhere on the page. Starfield flight and Bubbles are for everyone; Pipes, Pond and Lava lamp come with Glow. They're in your homepage's Page tab, under Background.

items.title: Songs that play by themselves
items.text: A homepage's first song now starts quietly when someone opens it, like MySpace did, and every player has a volume slider and bars that dance to the music. Rather it didn't? There's a switch in Settings.

items.title: Jump to the newest
items.text: Scrolled a long way up in a chat? A bar takes you straight back down to the newest messages.

items.title: Shift to delete
items.text: Hold Shift over one of your messages and a bin shows up: one click deletes it, without being asked.
